title: When a page opens in a space, make it the space's last page
statement: Whenever a page that belongs to a space is opened (DS02), remember it as that space's last page, and that space as the one last chosen.

title: When a page opens, move the active tab there
statement: Whenever a page is opened in the window (a selection, a link, the walk, quick open, the address), move the active tab's place there, never another tab's, even one that holds the page; Back and Forward step through the active tab's own history.

title: When the active tab changes, move the address to it
statement: Whenever the active tab changes (activated, cycled, a new tab in front, or a neighbor after a close), open its place's address and give the window its history, so the address and the window's Back and Forward follow the active tab.

title: When a page opens, note how many spaces there are
statement: Whenever a page opens and the products are listed, note whether two or more spaces are listed, so the rail shows as it did before the products are read.

title: When a page opens in the nav, open the nav's branch to it
statement: Whenever a page is opened in the nav (the first time the nav is shown, or after a move made in the nav), open every nav entry that holds the page, down to it; a move made elsewhere MUST leave the entries where they are.

title: When a stage is switched in place, replace the active tab's address
statement: Whenever a page is opened by a stage switched in place, replace the active tab's current entry with the new address, as one entry and not a move.

title: When a page opens on a stage, remember the stage
statement: Whenever a page opens on a stage, remember the stage as the last chosen, which a place whose address names none starts on.

title: When a page opens, keep the camera of the place left
statement: Whenever a page opens, keep the camera of the stage the place left with what it framed, so the place comes back as it was.

title: When a page opens in another product, mark the product left as looked at
statement: Whenever a page opens in another product's space, mark the product left as looked at, so its Changes can be compared with that moment.

title: When a window opens, start its app server
statement: Whenever a product window opens, start the server it loads Lathe from, as SP02 decides.

title: When a window closes, stop its server
statement: Whenever a product window closes, or the shell quits (also when it is stopped from a terminal), stop the server the shell started for it; quitting waits until each has stopped.

title: When a folder opens, put it first in the recent folders
statement: Whenever a product window opens, add its folder to the recent folders, and to the system's recent documents.

title: When a window closes, end its chat
statement: Whenever a product window closes, or the shell quits, its chat MUST end: its Claude Code and its listening stop, and quitting waits until each has stopped.

title: When the key bindings change, report the window's keys
statement: Whenever the key bindings change in a Product window, the window's keys MUST be reported to it, so its menus show the person's keys beside their commands at once.

title: When a theme is chosen, set the window's chrome to its colors
statement: Whenever a theme is chosen in a Product window, the window's chrome MUST take the theme's colors for the mode shown, and again when the mode or the system's appearance changes.

title: When data files change, report the window's error count
statement: Whenever a product's data files change, the window's count of check errors MUST be reported to it, so the Dock badge shows it for the focused window.
